summary: This CSS file styles the footer section of the About page, including links, copyright information, and social media icons.
evidence: The footerLinks class styles list items with margin-bottom
The footerLinks a class styles links with color, text-decoration, and hover effects
The copyright class styles the copyright text with center alignment, margin, padding, and border
The socialLinks class styles a flex container with gap and margin
The socialLinks a class styles social media icons with color, background, size, border-radius, and hover effects
